clips.title: The story
paras: Body and Heart is the culminating trial for young tauren druids seeking to master Bear Form. Dispatched by Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff, the initiate must travel to the border of Mulgore and the Barrens to summon and best Lunaclaw at the Moonkin Stone.

To truly follow the path of the Druid of the Claw, tauren initiates must unite spiritual conviction with physical resilience. After communion with the Great Bear Spirit in Moonglade, a druid's training is put to an active test. Turak Runetotem, the elder druid trainer atop the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, bestows Cenarion Lunardust upon worthy aspirants, charging them to seek out a sacred stone resting near the arid frontier where Mulgore meets the Barrens.

Resting west of Camp Taurajo, the Moonkin Stone marks a rare Cenarion site in southern Kalimdor. Moonkin are not native to the sun-scorched plains of central Kalimdor, making the presence of the guardian beast Lunaclaw deeply significant. By scattering the lunardust across the ancient monument, the druid calls forth Lunaclaw in battle. Defeating the creature proves the aspirant commands both strength of body and clarity of heart, earning the beast's blessing and unlocking the inner essence of the bear.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: On land west of Taurajo in the Barrens - just before it turns into Mulgore - lies a Moonkin Stone. The moonkin are special beasts, not native to these parts. Lunaclaw, the stone's defender, will face you when Cenarion Lunardust is applied to it. Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.
You've earned the right to use this Cenarion Lunardust, friend... Now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!

clips.title: Progress
paras: When you have faced the challenge that lies before you, your understanding of strength of body and strength of heart will be fully realized. Until that time, I cannot help you further.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have finally taken your large step into a much larger world, friend. I sense the teaching of the Great Bear Spirit within you, and I sense that you have received the strength that Lunaclaw possessed.
There are no further obstacles in your way... Let me now teach you what it means to be a Druid of the Claw!
